name: robot-heads-solid
description: Animated TV-headed robot avatars for Solid, drawn with Canvas 2D.

scripts.build: vite build && vite build --config vite.ssr.config.ts && bun run build:solid2 && bun run build:types
scripts.build:solid2: bun run setup:solid2 && cd solid2-toolchain && bun run build
scripts.typecheck: bun run setup:solid2 && tsc --noEmit && cd solid2-toolchain && bun run typecheck
scripts.build:site: bun run build && cd site && bun run build
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run build && cd site && bun run typecheck && bun run build
scripts.deploy: bun run build:site && cd site && bun run deploy
scripts.e2e:consumer: bun run build && bun run e2e:consumer:built
scripts.e2e:consumer:built: bun pm pack --filename test-results/consumer-solid1.tgz && bun pm pack --filename test-results/consumer-solid2.tgz && cd e2e/consumer && rm -f bun.lock && bun install --force && bun run typecheck && bun run build && node ssr.mjs && cd ../consumer-solid2 && rm -f bun.lock && bun install --force && bun run typecheck && bun run build && node ssr.mjs && cd ../.. && bunx playwright test --config playwright.consumer.config.ts && bunx playwright test --config playwright.consumer-solid2.config.ts
